discrepancies.explanation: The reference asks 'Why are you ready?' (or misheard 'cute yaar' as 'kyun taiyaar ho'), but the translation says 'Cute yaar'.
The reference says 'Don't lie' (झूठ तो मत बोलिए), but the translation says 'don't forget'.
The reference says 'not anymore' (अभी नहीं है) regarding a boyfriend, but the translation says 'is still there'.
The reference says 'Same here' (सेम है), but the translation says 'What ma'am'.
The reference says 'supervisor' (पर्यवेक्षक / परवेज है तो), which is translated as 'supervisor' but the transcription is slightly garbled.
The reference says 'dimag ho' (or similar garbled phrase), which the translation interprets as 'are you sick?'.
